content: The blizzard outside was a howling wall of white needles. Down the village lane, the wattle fences were burning, their flames whipped flat by the gale into trails of orange sparks. The screams of terror from the outlying huts were instantly swallowed by the roar of the storm.
critique: Sanderson: Strong biological limits and mechanical vector precision.
